changes: Written in JavaScript for magpie's plugin host instead of Rust compiled to a wasm pack for Agent2API; nothing of the wasm SDK or its host protocol is used.
What the wasm pack leaves to its host (the loopback listener, the Aliyun captcha page, account and state stores, the ledger) is implemented in the plugin itself.
The sign-in state kept by magpie's own account store replaces the pack's account records and compare-and-swap updates.
The caller's conversation id from magpie is hashed together with the account before it is sent as the vendor's session header.
With the vendor's captcha switched off, the authorization URL is requested without a receipt; the wasm pack treats that as a sign-in that can't start.
